viriccamāna.p: [Vi+rica+ya+māna] (ti) CL=7 There should be a Pali word for Viriñcamāna] (a) who is caused  diarrhoea; he. (Na) who vomits; he. who vomits blood; he.
a: ဝိရိစ္စမာန(တိ)

B:
viriccamāna： viriccamāna（ti）
ဝိရိစ္စမာန（တိ）

[ဝိ+ရိစ+ယ+မာန။ ဝိရိဉ္စမာန-ဟု ပါဠိရှိသင့်၏]

viriccati.cp: pass. of vireceti. to get purged.
viriccati.p: [Vi+rica+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Viricchate-saṃ.  from -Viriñcati] (A) cause diarrhoea (or) have frequent motions of the bowels. (B) vomit. (C) vomit blood.
a: ဝိရိစ္စတိ(ကမ္မ၊ကြိ)

viritta.p: [Vi+rica+ta] (ti) CL=7 Viritta-saṃ. Virikka-prā.]  (1) who have frequent motions of the bowels; he. (2) should be taken it out.
